Child-side half of BD-216's one-meter-row rule: run_admitted exports the token to its child as FROB_ENVELOPE_TOKEN=<token id>; admit_run in a frob run verb that finds a valid, unsettled token whose declared demand contains its own demand adopts the token's scope and class and writes no meter row (the parent's settlement is the arm's only row); a token that does not contain the verb's demand is refused with 761. Without it a gate campaign's own arms are re-admitted under adhoc (E0) and metered twice. Add a test (one row per arm, scope taken from the token).
